semantic.justification: Represented native RTF export now carries current-model character decoration, links and paragraph indentation; complete upstream responsibilities remain unverified. RTF run collection now borrows actual SwAttrIter/CharFormat item stacks for named and automatic hints. Every represented script font is registered before the font table is serialized; style and run property modes are distinguished. The source RTLAndCJKState consumer is exposed, but complete native MSWord script/bidi production, full font identity/encoding and parser language mapping remain unverified.
